scientificPlacementFindings.rationale: Original practical goals are appropriate as explicitly additional interdisciplinary learning projects in a broad upper-secondary pilot. Their profiles retain real original execution, safety/protection, controls and independent transfer. Field correlation, habitat judgement and experimental cause remain distinct; paper values do not fulfill experimental work.

Food/pharmacy topics have an official year11NTG origin and fit the existing CrossStage progression. Explicit placement does not createQ12/13 GA/EA or generalGK/LK official scope. Model pharmacy calculations/research remain chemical learning, not individualized treatment.

f4d retains requires62149 and8761. The former already has its two amino-acid children visible; the successor explicitly adds all three current8761 carbohydrate children. Configuration, ring-chain equilibrium and controlled assays are available as separate assessable own targets; no prerequisite mastery is inferred from polarimetry and no canonical edge is changed.

Existing memory_required originsb92/9de/853 each see their corresponding narrow recall unit14083/d14/be8. AGENTS7.2 and the current contract require at least one referenced memory unit per view, not the broad historical organic deck as well. The three added carbohydrate atoms already have no_memory_needed. No card/body/M decision changes or new M approval are made.

retainedSourceLimits.limit: Broad generic/cluster source rows are not whole atomic descendant clearance. Concrete partial witnesses are kept separate in each row.
Biotechnology and chemical preparation remain separate practical paths with official project selection.
Specific-rotation identification cell does not by itself grant the full current known-solute concentration/uncertainty competence.
Configuration/conformation853 is own authored extension; this literal stereocentre/type cell does not require every child.
Historical C15-S01 NTG course boundary retained.
Historical C15-S02/S03 research/application/material findings are not automatically closed. This review does not grant source-whole credit from current text or native DP status.
